Truth: 6 of the source PRD's 15 topics DO exist (orders/paid, orders/create, orders/cancelled, orders/updated, orders/fulfilled, orders/partially_fulfilled) — orders/paid is live, so Charged maps from it as the source PRD intended, and the fulfilment topics it believed were blocked on the Fulfillment Module are available. 9 do NOT exist (customers/create+update, checkouts/create+update+delete, fulfillments/create+update, draft_orders/create+update) — tracked as platform asks in TODO.md §1. A self-serve POST /api/v1/app-webhooks subscription API DOES exist ({eventName, webhookUrl, secretKey?, customHeaders?}), so the source PRD's subscription model is real — it lives on the platform, not in this repo. Other decisions: pasted <script> instead of ScriptTag injection (D1) — but the live spec shows web_pixel/app_embed extension machinery worth investigating (TODO.md §3); app calls CleverTap's public Events API rather than Ratio emitting Shopify-format payloads, which DELETES the source PRD's highest-likelihood (H) risk of CleverTap not prioritising Ratio (D3); identity bridge reads metadata.user_data off OpenStore pixel events instead of requiring a KwikPass JS change, deleting an external GoKwik dependency (D4); prices are integer PAISE and must be /100 before sending, contradicting the source PRD's 'decimal rupees' claim (D5, per learnings.md 2026-06-22). Closest in-repo reference is the moengage app (pixel + config + event map); loyalty is the reference for order webhooks and for the precedent of re-grounding a source PRD against the live spec. Unlike moengage, this module DOES need CryptoService: the CleverTap Passcode is a write secret, encrypted at rest, never sent to the browser.

KEY DESIGN FOR THE UNRESOLVED R-ITEMS: every payload assumption is isolated in helpers/fixtures/order-payloads.ts behind one pure mapper, with '// R2: unverified' comments on each unconfirmed field — so capturing a real orders/paid delivery changes ONLY the fixture (and maybe the mapper), never a test name or the structure. Highest-value tests: order-event.mapper.test.ts (table-driven paise->rupees, since wrong units inflate revenue 100x), forwarding.service.test.ts (insert-before-call so a mid-forward crash leaves status=failed not a silent gap; duplicate key = no second fetch; CleverTap 5xx still resolves so the platform gets 2xx and stops redelivering), topics.test.ts (asserts the handler topic set equals STATE.json.webhooks exactly - the guard against R1's silent topic-mismatch skip), and the admin test that an untouched passcode field OMITS passcode from the PUT rather than sending '' which would clear it. TRD.md written. Design = the moengage app plus (a) an encrypted secret and (b) an outbound API client. Key decisions: 6 separate order handlers delegating to one shared ClevertapForwardingService; NEW clevertap_forwarded_events table with UNIQUE(merchant_id, idempotency_key) giving OUTBOUND idempotency independent of core's retry-windowed inbound dedupe (a delivery can be logged then fail mid-forward, and re-sending Charged would double-count revenue) — the same rows power GET /clevertap/api/status; passcode uses wizzy's write-only secret semantics (absent=untouched, ''=clear, value=encrypt) and is never returned, never in the pixel prelude, never logged; Charged fires ONLY from orders/paid so orders/create cannot double-count; money converted paise->rupees via one unit-tested helper; forwarding failures mark the row failed and still return 2xx so the platform does not redeliver forever during a CleverTap outage. 8 R-items in TRD §8: R1 (confirm all 9 event_type strings against REAL deliveries — mismatch = silent handler skip, the worst failure mode) and R2 (real orders/paid payload + confirm paise for orders, currently only verified for products) must be resolved before writing order-event.mapper.ts; R4/R5 (CleverTap Events API contract + Web SDK URL/region init) before the client and pixel; R7/R8 accepted unresolved as tracked non-blockers.
